item.title: Healey to Scrap UK’s Standing Charges on Gas Bills
item.description: Standing charges on gas bills will be scrapped for British households as soon as next year, Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey will announce today.

item.title: UK Budget Day: Here's What to Expect From Healey
item.description: UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey's budget plans, due to be outlined in the House of Commons at 12:30 p.m. on Wednesday, are expected to include targeted rebates on heating bills, an increase to the national living wage and a freeze of fuel duty. Bloomberg's Louise Moon has a preview. (Source: Bloomberg)
